result.title: Competence-Aware Orchestration for LLM-Based Multi-Agent Systems
result.summary: LLM-based multi-agent systems (MAS) have emerged as a promising paradigm for enhancing complex reasoning through role specialization and collaboration, yet a key challenge remains: how can collaboration be adapted to a backbone's competence on the current query? This problem matters because more collaboration is not always better--richer coordination may help on difficult cases, but it also incurs additional token cost and redundant interactions. We propose a two-stage competence-aware framework for automatic MAS orchestration. It first models the LLM backbone's task-conditioned competence for the current query, and then uses this signal to adapt role activation and the communication graph. Across six benchmarks, our method achieves an average score of 93.81%. Experiments with six LLM backbones of varying competence levels further show that our method adjusts collaboration according to the inferred competence: for higher-competence backbones, it improves average accuracy from 87.22 to 89.97 while reducing token cost by 36.26%; for lower-competence backbones, it yields a further average gain of 4.58 points over existing methods. The same trend also holds on unseen backbones.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文提出两阶段的「能力感知」框架来自动编排 LLM 多智能体系统：先估计 backbone 针对当前查询的任务条件能力，再据此调整角色激活与通信图，在六个基准上报告平均 93.81 分，并显示高能力 backbone 在提升准确率的同时减少约 36% token 成本。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「按任务条件能力自适应决定协作量与 token 预算」的信号，可能为 LVR 中动态计算分配与是否继续推理（THINK/STOP）提供线索；但工作为纯文本 MAS 编排、无视觉状态，能力信号能否迁移到 latent 推理的收益—成本决策尚需核查。
